story_type: crewed Soyuz launch: liftoff, four boosters fall away in the sky, onboard camera over Earth
hook: Three people rode this rocket off the steppe of Kazakhstan.
narration: Three people were sitting on top of this rocket as it left Kazakhstan.
NASA astronaut Anil Menon flew with cosmonauts Pyotr Dubrov and Anna Kikina on Soyuz MS-29, on July fourteenth.
The engines lit, and the Soyuz climbed off its pad at the Baikonur Cosmodrome.
Within moments it was a streak of fire high in the sky.
A Soyuz drops its four side boosters together, and they spread apart in a shape called the Korolev cross.
A camera on the spacecraft looked back at Earth as it climbed toward orbit.
[short pause] Then the crew had two orbits to catch the space station.
outcome: Soyuz MS-29 docked to the International Space Station the same day, with all three aboard.
title: Soyuz drops four boosters at once
description:
NASA astronaut Anil Menon and Roscosmos cosmonauts Pyotr Dubrov and Anna Kikina launched on Soyuz MS-29 from the Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan on July 14, 2026, and docked to the International Space Station the same day.
